official_title: Commission Implementing Decision of 23.6.2025 on a standardisation request to CEN and CENELEC as regards high-risk AI systems in support of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 and repealing Implementing Decision C(2023) 3215

review_qualification.confirmed: Official final text and adoption on 23 June 2025 confirmed. This date is the adoption date, not an established public-release date.
review_qualification.unresolved: Publication date not yet confirmed. The former value 2025-06-23 was unsupported as a publication date and is retained in the correction history, not used as a replacement for missing evidence.

corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: Expanded evidence review update, 6 September 2026: fresh authentic English, French and German texts and the Commission register confirm C(2025)3871 dated 23 June 2025. The register transmission timestamp, 27 June 2025, is not explicitly public release. CEN/CENELEC's November 2025 Technical Board newsletter corroborates Commission issue on 23 June and technical-board decisions applicable from 2 July; these are process dates, not publication evidence, and the CEN host is outside the active official-EU source predicate. No qualifying exact-day public manifestation has been established. The legacy publication date remains unverified; the record retains its expanded-review hold. Article 5's anomalous identifier is preserved without silent correction.
